analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We share your information with business and integrated partners in order to provide the Services.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: Snap Inc. consists of different subsidiaries owned by us. We may share your information within those internal subsidiaries as needed to carry out our Services.

analysis.headline: Uses Your Info for Ads
analysis.quote: We use your interests and preferences from the information we’ve collected to personalize, target, and measure ads.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Content
analysis.quote: Our algorithms and machine learning models take into account the conversations Snapchatters are having with My AI to improve the responses from My AI.

analysis.headline: Keeps Data for Legal Reasons
analysis.quote: In some cases we need to comply with legal requirements to store your data which stops us from deleting your information.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Track You
analysis.quote: We may use information collected on an advertiser’s website to show you more relevant ads.

analysis.headline: Collects Precise Location Data
analysis.quote: If you’ve explicitly granted device-level permissions, device information may also include...location information (precise location through methods like GPS signals).

analysis.headline: Others Can Save Your Content
analysis.quote: Keep in mind that Snapchatters who view your Snaps, Chats, and any other content, can always screenshot that content, save it, or copy it outside the Snapchat app.

analysis.headline: Region-Specific Rights Apply
analysis.quote: Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights, this section provides more details on region specific information.
